# SD-WAN vendor logos

NetEm shows the logo of the SD-WAN vendor under test in the showroom header, the Command Center and
Settings. Each logo is the vendor's official artwork, cropped to the artwork with a small margin and
scaled to 160 px high (or 720 px wide) for sharp display at twice its on-screen size. They are drawn
for light backgrounds, so the app places them on a white card.

The logos are trademarks of their owners. NetEm uses them only to name the appliance under test and
claims no endorsement.

To add a vendor, add it to `SDWAN_VENDORS` in `app.py` and put a transparent PNG named after its id
here, prepared the same way.
